nights.title: Streetlight Manifesto
nights.name: Streetlight Manifesto
nights.description: American ska punk band from New Jersey
nights.extract: Streetlight Manifesto is an American ska punk band from New Brunswick, New Jersey, formed in 2002. They released their debut album, Everything Goes Numb, through Victory Records on August 26, 2003. The band headlined and sold out their first concert at Rutgers University in New Brunswick on December 9, 2003. Several members were previously involved in New Jersey's third wave ska scene, most notably Tomas Kalnoky, a founding member of Catch 22, and members of the band One Cool Guy. Kalnoky and several other members also attended Rutgers University.

nights.title: Dexter and The Moonrocks
nights.name: Dexter and the Moonrocks
nights.extract: Dexter and the Moonrocks are an American rock band from Throckmorton, Texas formed in 2021. Combining elements of country and rock music, they have described their genre as "Western space grunge", which they chose to name their 2024 EP after. The band gained traction after a clip for their song "Couch" went viral on TikTok. Their song "Freakin' Out" peaked at number 33 on the Billboard Hot 100.

nights.title: Brett Eldredge: Glow 10 Year Anniversary Tour
nights.name: Brett Eldredge
nights.extract: Brett Ryan Eldredge is an American country music singer, songwriter and record producer. Eldredge has had five No. 1 singles on the Billboard Country Airplay chart, three of which came from his debut album, Bring You Back: "Don't Ya", "Beat of the Music", and "Mean to Me".
